name: Void Citadel
_: Region 4's boss (S5-4, feat/boss-region-4; docs/plans/s5-boss-regions.md §4.5 and §6.4; the owner's banner in docs/design/boss-banners/): the Void Citadel, the final regional boss. An octagonal fortress - one solid hull from end to end (rows 0-3, columns 14-49), the weapons set into it in two blocks, one each side of the centre - with the black void core at the centre and a salvo spire on a gantry at each end. Seen from below: the hull, the weapons in their bays, a one-row armour belt (row 4) under them, nothing below the belt (decision AP: one ship, armour reads as armour, the band ends at its last row). The gravity well (owner decision of 2026-10-13): while any spire stands, the player's ship is pulled sideways towards the core's column and the core pulses; destroying both spires switches the pull off and opens the core (its cover is the spires and the shutter plate in front of it). Phase A-2 (the owner's smoke of 2026-10-14): two laser cannons hug the core on both sides (slots 1 and 2), each behind its own belt plate, so the well pulls the ship across their beams; two more emitters (slots 3 and 4; every slot enabled on levels 10-12) and the outer guns sit behind the outer plates; two open guns stand in bays between the blocks and fire from the first frame. The boss falls with its last weapon - the core is one. Art drawn by the agent with scripts/boss-r4-art.mjs (decision G); the owner retouches the PNGs. Hit points (Phase B, the owner's standing answer: EASY shorter, MEDIUM about 105 s, HARD as close to region 1's 154 s as data allows; plan s5-boss-regions §6.4.7): the spires' and cannons' first, then the spires one column inward when EASY still ran longer than MEDIUM, then the end phase (the core, its lens) for HARD - spires 6, the core 12, its lens 10, cannons 10, guns 7, plates 6: MEASURED 91.8 / 102.2 / 158.3 s by the aiming bot's ratio (EASY / MEDIUM / HARD). fix/r4-immobile (journal §AR): the band still and centred, the ship compacted to columns 14-49 (the bays closed up, the hull 16-47), no vents, the cannons two cells wide against the core (their beams meet the lens's: no refuge in reach of the core's endgame), the pull G2; every module x 1.75, then the end phase - spires 11, the core 29, its lens 26, cannons 18, guns 12, plates 10: MEASURED 92.6 / 107.3 / 154.3 s. fix/interceptor-speed (owner answer Q4 of 2026-10-14; plan interceptor-speed §5.5-§6): the catchable escort, centred on the ship, sits in the line of the shots aimed at the boss and takes them (44-57 a fight, 4-7 before), so every module about a fifth lighter - spires 9, the core 23, its lens 21, cannons 14, guns 10, plates 8: MEASURED 100.2 / 107.0 / 139.3 s on the review probe.

palette._: COLPF0 pale steel (the belt's and the turrets' faces, the core's rim), COLPF1 mid steel (trim, edges), COLPF2 void magenta (the core's glow, the spires' coils, lights, damage glow, sparks; hue 326, clear of the ally steel $84 at 226 on levels 10-12), COLPF3 the hull's dark violet bulk (hue 294).

rowPalette._: feat/boss-art (the owner's variant B; colours as Atari800's PAL palette shows them, docs/plans/boss-art.md §3.4): light from above - COLPF1, a gold trim (region 3's recipe: a saturated trim over light faces), $EC on the deck, $EA, $E8 at the belt; COLPF3 the citadel's violet bulk, $64 on top, $62 from the belt down - two switches (rows 1 and 3; the owner's choice after Phase A: keep about 342 native cycles of M6 headroom). The b3 flash swaps purple $58 and the bulk (Atari800 RGB distance 90 / 129).

motion._: fix/r4-immobile (the owner's smoke of the Void Citadel: the drift with the gravity well was a mishmash): still - 0 frames per colour clock, the band at position 32 for the whole fight, the ship (columns 14-49) centred on screen; the win's shake stays.

fire._: One countdown as region 1; the finale on (fire.finaleCooldown, the S5-2 placeholders' value for regions 2-4): the final boss's worst case.

escort._: Region 1's cadence (owner decision AI, regions 2-4 follow region 1): the first escort at the first weapon kill, then one every 150 + 0..63 frames.

capped._: Never used on levels 10-12 (tier 4 enables every slot); the converter requires it.

gravity._: S5-4 (owner decisions of 2026-10-13 / 2026-10-14): the gravity well. While either spire stands, in the fight, the ship alive, the ship steps 2 colour clocks towards the axis every framesPerStep frames (G1); the core pulses (its hit flash) every pulseFrames; the gravity column (missile M0, white) shows the axis from the band down, an S-wave moving waveStep lines every 8 frames, flaring in the axis's warning, giving way to its beam. The axis is core-lens's beam: the well pulls the ship into its danger (owner answer 4). Both spires destroyed: the pull, the pulse and the column stop at once. fix/r4-immobile: G2 - 2 colour clocks every 4 frames (the owner's answer 1 after G1+ and G2 were compared).

nozzles._: fix/r4-immobile (the owner: remove the engines): none on the band - a still citadel has no drive; the converter still gives the two nozzle codes their phases (unseen).

modules._: The void core (owner answer 4 of 2026-10-14: 3 x 3, round on screen). It cannot be hurt while a spire or its lens stands.
modules.name: core

modules._: The core's own beam (owner answer 4 of 2026-10-14: the well must pull the player into danger): the lens under the core fires down the gravity column - the well's axis is its beam, the column flares in its warning. Covered by the spires (the well powers it): untouchable while the well is on, yet firing (the well's code counts its reload); once both spires fall it is exposed, fires at once and can be destroyed.
modules.name: core-lens

modules._: The laser cannons beside the core (Phase A-2, the owner's smoke of 2026-10-14), each behind its own belt plate; independent (owner answer 3). fix/r4-immobile (the owner's answer 2, option 3): two cells wide, hugging the core, so their beams meet the lens's - no spot in reach of the core's endgame out of the lasers.
